title: 如果孩子有这一种表现，说明 TA 真的真的很爱你 | 原文
content: Babies and children commonly express affection by persistently feeding their parents and caregivers, from offering saliva-coated snacks as toddlers to saving school treats to share. This behavior stems from a caregiving instinct that predates language, rooted in insula brain circuitry that produces deep social satisfaction. The act of feeding activates neural responses typically associated with drug cravings and meditation-like calmness. Parental reactions to this feeding matter significantly, as rejecting the child's food offerings can diminish this natural caregiving impulse.

title: 黑莓不卖手机后，反而更赚钱了
content: BlackBerry exited the smartphone market in 2016 but transformed into a profitable software company. Its 2010 acquisition of QNX, a secure microkernel operating system, became the foundation of its revival. QNX now powers over 275 million vehicles for manufacturers including Mercedes, BMW, and Ford, and extends to robotics, medical devices, and industrial systems through partnerships with Nvidia and others. Complemented by NATO-grade encryption from its 2014 Secusmart acquisition, BlackBerry achieved 86% gross margins and its first positive operating cash flow since 2017. The company's stock surged 200%, demonstrating how core capabilities in secure, reliable systems successfully transferred across industries.

Touchscreen is positioned as supplementary input for AI interactions rather than replacing keyboard and trackpad.

content: Apple is cutting over 200 positions across Siri, Vision Pro, and intelligent systems teams. The restructuring aims to redirect resources toward artificial intelligence and new devices, with Apple stating it is realigning teams to drive business growth and optimize user experience.

title: 英伟达将向 AI 模型初创企业 Poolside 支付 60 亿美元，用于授权及人才收购交易
content: Nvidia will pay $6 billion to AI startup Poolside for software licensing and talent acquisition. The deal includes a $1 billion investment at a $12 billion pre-money valuation and job offers to 109 employees who worked on the "Laguna" AI model. Poolside will distribute the $6 billion to investors by end of 2026. The three co-founders will remain, and the transaction is not classified as an acquisition.

title: 字节 Seed 再调整：预训练、强化学习与 Agent 研发全面重构
content: ByteDance's AI division Seed has reorganized, creating four new departments under Wu Yonghui. Li Chenggang leads Pretrain Data for multimodal models; Tang Shengyu heads Horizon RL for reinforcement learning; Qin Yujia manages B-facing Product Posttrain-Work for enterprise Agent solutions; and Zhu Wenjia handles C-facing Product Posttrain-Chat for conversational AI. The restructuring strengthens model development chains and differentiates enterprise and consumer offerings. ByteDance declined to comment.

title: 神秘「牛来」大模型刷屏，限时免费
content: An anonymous AI model called Ox Alpha ("Ox" means cow/bull in Chinese, nicknamed "牛来" or "cow is coming") appeared on OpenRouter with 1 million token context, multimodal input, and free access. Early tests show strong coding performance near top models on DeepSWE benchmarks. Evidence strongly suggests it's Zhipu's unreleased GLM-5.3 Flash, based on matching vision encoders, tokenizers, and routing behavior. Another anonymous model "korrine" is also being tested, with speculation pointing to Kimi, Qwen, or MiMo. Anonymous testing helps companies conduct public stress tests, gather unbiased user feedback, and generate marketing buzz before official launches.

title: 都在抢芯片公司
content: Major tech firms are aggressively securing chip supply chains through equity investments, long-term contracts, and acquisitions rather than simple spot purchases. GPU makers like Nvidia and AMD are acquiring startups to build system-level capabilities. Cloud providers including Google, Meta, and AWS are locking in production capacity via equity stakes and multi-year deals. AI companies such as Anthropic and OpenAI are embedding themselves deeper into semiconductor supply chains. This rush is driven by misaligned supply-demand cycles, fierce competition for limited capacity, growing need for customized chips as Moore's law slows, and geopolitical supply chain risks. However, these capital-intensive strategies carry management complexity, talent retention challenges, and potential asset stranding if demand falls short. Competition is now shifting upstream to advanced packaging, semiconductor equipment, optical interconnects, and cooling infrastructure.

title: 600 亿、5000 亿：美国 AI 开始疯狂借钱
content: Broadcom is borrowing over $600 billion, potentially exceeding $1 trillion with subordinated debt, to build AI data centers through a new company backed by Blackstone and Apollo. The centers will rent computing power to firms like Anthropic, creating leveraged returns for all parties. Similarly, Nvidia formed a $500 billion financing platform with six financial institutions, lending to AI companies to purchase its GPUs. Meanwhile, Chinese AI firms like DeepSeek raised far smaller amounts but achieved comparable results more efficiently, potentially threatening the U.S. AI debt bubble.

title: 对AI大模型竞争下半场的思考
content: Global AI competition is shifting from benchmark scores to usage volume and unit economics. As frontier models converge in capability, price becomes decisive: Chinese models like Kimi K3 match top Western performance at 1/25th the cost, driving enterprise migration. China's open-weight strategy versus Western closed-source approaches is accelerating developer adoption overseas. Structural advantages in electricity and talent costs support sustained price competition. With valuation premia built on technological moats, overseas vendors face pressure as financials replace benchmarks as the ultimate test—requiring proof of customer stickiness and cash flow generation rather than raw capability leadership.

title: 突发，DeepSeek宣布周末全天谷价，以后周末上班更划算？
content: DeepSeek adjusted its API pricing, making weekends entirely off-peak starting August 23. Developers benefit from lower costs for batch tasks without avoiding peak hours. However, some workers fear companies may shift schedules to exploit cheaper weekend rates, similar to how AI short drama teams already schedule heavy rendering at night. One programmer reported their company implemented weekend work to save token costs. Speculation suggests peak pricing may correlate with DeepSeek's internal model training needs.

title: 越失败越上瘾，年轻人爱上“用身体刷短视频”，一年消费五六千
content: Indoor climbing gyms are booming in China's cities, attracting young people with short, intense challenges that deliver instant feedback. The sport's appeal lies in its "gamified" progression—fine-grained difficulty levels let beginners feel tangible improvement. However, gyms face high costs: expensive imported holds, frequent route resets, and rising rents. Major chains now prioritize newcomer experience with "beginner zones," coaching, and amenities, shifting from硬核 enthusiast spaces to accessible consumer venues. While annual participant spending can reach 5,000–10,000 yuan, retention remains uncertain. The industry concentrates in tier-one cities where sufficient density of climbers and infrastructure sustains business viability.

content: The article critiques media narratives blaming "broken" job markets when job seekers fail after mass-applying. It argues AI-enabled resume blasting creates undifferentiated mediocrity at scale. As counterexample, Anna Reich landed a nonexistent position by researching Creator Science founder Jay Clouse for two years, then publishing a detailed Substack analysis identifying gaps in his paternity-leave plans. The author emphasizes that high-value, unscalable effort—risking public judgment with original work—remains the best strategy for standing out, as AI makes mass replication effortless and therefore worthless.
